outcome: Maternal outcomes (blood transfusion, urinary bladder injury, intensive care unit admission, death)
Neonatal outcomes (intensive care unit admission, death)
cohort: The cohort consisted of all women who were diagnosed with uterine rupture during cesarean delivery or laparotomy.
finding: Despite a higher incidence of uterine rupture in women undergoing a trial of labour, outcomes are less favourable when rupture occurs outside the trial of labour and if the uterus is unscarred.
mod_finding: When uterine rupture occurs, outcomes are less favourable if it happens outside a trial of labour, particularly in women with a single prior CD who did not attempt TOLAC.
